description: A dark red rusted octagon sign with a white border is connected to a square metal black pole and in the middle of the sign, in white text, is "STOP." On the bottom of the white boarder is a rust color. At the base of the pole is a concrete block, and it sits on a patch of green grass. The shadow of the black pole is partially cast onto the concrete block to the left of the pole. A grey concrete sidewalk is behind the sign and connects to the grass patch in the foreground. Four square wooden poles with a brown and black trashcan in the middle of them are to the back left of the sign sitting in a grass field.
